gen-dafont-galaxy-gf-sono: Approachable and wide-set, this sans keeps its lowercase close to cap height and each a slightly ajar. Sono's easy spacing is what counts, giving Galaxy's dense, uniform-width letters room to feel commanding.
gen-dafont-galaxy-gf-ubuntu-sans: Bent copper pipe, washer-sized eyes: Ubuntu Sans looks modern and slightly unfinished at the curves. Galaxy, loose and unbroken in line width, takes the commanding top spot while the sans-serif text carries the quieter detail.
gen-dafont-galaxy-gf-vend-sans: Galaxy brings a cosmic, commanding presence, with line width that never wavers and loose letterfit that leaves each shape room. Vend Sans keeps long text moving with a ruler-drawn line.
gen-dafont-groovy-gf-aldrich: Groovy is friendly and funky, with a c that almost shuts. Aldrich counters with cupped, open rounds and an x-height near cap height, so closed and open shapes trade places down the line.
gen-dafont-groovy-gf-amiko: Amiko reads modern and plain-spoken, its thick, crayon-like strokes ending in terminals that flare outward like tongs. Groovy supplies the fun up top; this sans does the steady reading.
gen-dafont-groovy-gf-anek-devanagari: Anek Devanagari opens its letter mouths wide, with a deep middle zone that feels modern and spare. Anek Devanagari's openness is the standout, set against Groovy's closed, uniform-stroke letters.
gen-dafont-groovy-gf-anek-latin: Anek Latin reads clean and level-headed, its lowercase rising nearly to cap height and every round held open. Groovy bends cable-like lines into play; this sans keeps the text legible.
gen-dafont-groovy-gf-anek-telugu: Clean and approachable, Anek Telugu lets its wide, generous bowls and unsealed rounds set the reading rhythm. And a full paragraph glides along smoothly after Groovy's closed, uniform-stroke heading.
gen-dafont-groovy-gf-arimo: Friendly through and through, Groovy nearly seals its letters, while Arimo, a sans-serif, leaves its rounded glyphs spaciously open. Arimo then reads smoothly down a long column without fuss.
gen-dafont-groovy-gf-cossette-texte: A narrow slit where the c almost closes marks Groovy as friendly and funky, with loosely tracked lowercase. And Cossette Texte, with wide-eyed e's and a prominent x-height, is the open counterweight to those closed shapes.
